channel.title: Updates on Phillip Stoneman
channel.description: Recent content in Updates on Phillip Stoneman

item.title: Reading the news
item.description: After a decade producing and presenting shows, I made my debut at the top of the hour.

item.title: Sam Smith support
item.description: I picked singer-songwriter Josie Oliver to open for their incredible London show, through BBC Introducing.

item.title: Rik Mayall Comedy Festival
item.description: Co-curated a line-up of 12 future stars of stand-up across two stages with BBC Upload, whose sets were broadcast on-air.

item.title: Radio 1 Big Weekend
item.description: I picked rising star of lo-fi, Rubii, to close the BBC Introducing stage at Radio 1’s Big Weekend in Sunderland.

item.title: Stoke 100 DJ mixes
item.description: Through BBC Introducing, six incredible producers were picked to showcase their work, filmed at iconic locations to mark the city’s centenary.

item.title: Bench-Warmers
item.description: Encompassing the Olympics, Paralympics and the European Championships, I hosted BBC Hereford & Worcester’s Monday and Friday night summer sport shows.

item.title: The Body in the Tree
item.description: Co-produced and shaped sound design for the BBC true crime podcast that was featured on TV and inspired a dance.
